mapper.insert: insert into merchant_users (merchant_id, user_id, create_by, update_by) values (#{merchantId}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
insert ignore into merchant_users (merchant_id, user_id, create_by, update_by) values (#{merchantId}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.delete: delete from merchant_users where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.openid, u.create_time, mu.create_time as bind_time from merchant_users mu join sys_user u on u.user_id = mu.user_id where mu.merchant_id = #{merchantId} order by mu.create_time desc, u.user_id desc

select count(distinct u.user_id) from sys_user u join merchant_users mu on mu.user_id = u.user_id join merchants m on m.id = mu.merchant_id
and ( u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.openid like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(u.user_id as char) like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.openid, count(distinct mu.merchant_id) as merchant_count, group_concat(distinct m.name order by m.name separator ', ') as merchant_names, u.create_time, u.update_time, min(mu.create_time) as bind_time from sys_user u join merchant_users mu on mu.user_id = u.user_id join merchants m on m.id = mu.merchant_id where u.user_id = #{userId} group by u.user_id, u.user_name, u.openid, u.create_time, u.update_time
